subject.why: The bench and blossoming cherry tree are clearly depicted with petals on the seat as requested.

category.why: A simple strip of grass forms the ground plane, set against a blue sky with soft cumulus clouds.

clean.why: There is no text, UI, watermark, or characters.

framing.why: The tree canopy and trunk heavily crowd and are cut off by the top and right edges, leaving no top margin.

colour.why: Colours are bright, saturated, and warm, with strong contrast against the sky.

detail.why: Shapes are clean and chunky without noisy surface micro-details.

style.why: The rendering matches the smooth, 3D stylized volume and satin sheen of the references.

fix: Scale down and reposition the tree so its entire canopy fits within the frame with clear sky margins at the top and sides.
